order: fresh context and page per trial; iterations 1..3, factors in listed order; arms 0->1 on odd iterations, arms 1->0 on even iterations; reuse browser only
target: Museum #Select [role=button] with pointer-history Select h2 then programmatic locator.focus, Space, Escape
sequence: optional common clearing of empty style markers in both normalized-prelude arms

invariantPolicy.prelude: Strict target Select subtree/attributes and layout at immediately-before-focus, not full-document DOM; if unlike, UNCONFIRMED and no factor causal claim
invariantPolicy.empty-style: Two exact target markers may differ only by empty style attr; reject unexpected DOM nodes/attributes; it is a diagnostic intervention, never product fix
invariantPolicy.pre-screenshot: Before-photo target DOM matches, record DOM mutations after screenshot, not assumed neutral
invariantPolicy.full-probe: Common static DOM/layout equality; timeline event requirements apply only in full-probe arm
invariantPolicy.prelude-normalized: Run same targeted empty-style removal operation in both arms after common normalize, while keeping original DOM/attribute before and after normalization; compare exact Select subtree immediately before focus. Neutralization is a diagnostic intervention, not proof of no effect.

guards: No auto expansion if equivalence is UNCONFIRMED
Do not treat focus-visible=false alone as product defect
No force click, arbitrary sleeps, app/SDK/lock changes
Independent evidence review required before causal conclusion
Stage 3 HOLD / root cause UNKNOWN / #23 not accepted
For the normalized prelude comparison, preserve both pre/post normalization snapshots and do not claim removing empty attrs is behaviorally neutral.
